name: Sudou Makoto
source:
A first-year student at Seishin Academy, she is an energetic girl who is a member of the track and field club. She looks up to her seniors, [url=/c121751]Fujima Nagisa[/url] and [url=/c133948]Himuro Aya[/url], and wants to be like them.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/saiminseishidou/character_page011.html]official site[/url]]
